runtime_current: I_cmd[k-1] — the command this ECU itself sent one period ago. NO measured current feedback is required.
runtime_force: F_des[k] (N) — desired damping force from the upper-level controller, divided by f_scale
sampling: x/v/a/I/T/F sampled at 1 kHz and decimated by taking every 10th sample at phase 0; NO filter is needed, so there is no filter to match
state_reset: GRU hidden state and I_cmd history reset at every power-up / new recording
ecu_requirements: 100 Hz task rate with the previous command kept in RAM
1 kHz acquisition of x/v/a and F_des at the same phase-0 index
no current sensor required (this is the point of V25.2)
caveat: labels are proxy commands derived from measured current under the one-step assumption; real ECU command accuracy is unverified
